entries.fidelity_comment: The Chinese large-explosion label identifies Explosn, distinct from the preceding Self-Destruct entry. The eight-character battle label uses Explosn so adjacent moves remain visually separated.

Corrects the swapped witness: the Chinese explicitly names a pointed-horn drill, which is Horn Drill rather than Guillotine. The executable eight-character battle cell displays HornDril for the full move name Horn Drill.

Corrects the reciprocal witness swap: the Chinese scissor-decapitation label identifies Guillotne, not Horn Drill. The executable eight-character battle cell displays Guillotn for the full move name Guillotne.
The Chinese label directly means singing and identifies Sing.

The reviewed demon-kiss label and executable move slot identify Lovely Kiss; the unreadable old graphics are not retained. The executable eight-character battle cell displays LovlyKis for the full move name Lovely Kiss.
The Chinese supersonic-wave label directly identifies Supersonic. The executable eight-character battle cell displays Supersnc for the full move name Supersonic.
The Chinese sword-dance label directly identifies Swords Dance. The executable eight-character battle cell displays SwrdDnce for the full move name Swords Dance.
The Chinese cry or growl label identifies Growl.
Corrects the old Bulk Up mismatch: the Chinese explicitly means acting cute or charming, identifying Charm.
The Chinese curl-into-a-ball label and move slot identify Defense Curl. The executable eight-character battle cell displays DefCurl for the full move name Defense Curl.
The Chinese hardening label directly identifies Harden.
The Chinese tail-wagging label identifies TailWhip in this move-table slot. The eight-character battle label uses TailWhip so adjacent moves remain visually separated.
Corrects the old Charm mismatch: the Chinese explicitly means tickling, identifying Tickle.
The Chinese smoke-screen label directly identifies Smokescreen. The executable eight-character battle cell displays SmokScrn for the full move name Smokescreen.
